## Search-intent policy
- Questions are phrased around real user tasks rather than keyword stuffing.
- Curated FAQ content is used where first-party product knowledge exists.
- No claim of private search-volume data is made.
- The public site remains the source of truth for tool behavior, limits, processing and pricing.
